method: Stream each permitted input and its expanded payload in 65536-byte chunks; count bytes without retaining content. Resolve dev input paths only from each named dev manifest's staging.files.source. No genome hashes are used.
margin: consumer files: 25% above observed maxima; whole genomes: above the largest kind people receive, with room for an uncompressed VCF
limitation: The four tracked demo persona files have no input-genome path or participant reference. Their genome sizes cannot be measured without an input mapping. The current limits are verified against all three permitted dev inputs; they must be rechecked when demo input files are identified.

typical_sizes.consumer_whole_genome_vcf: 200-800 MB compressed (e.g. a Veritas or Nebula genome VCF)
typical_sizes.complete_genomics_var_file: about 270 MB as bzip2, 1.5-1.6 GB expanded
typical_sizes.not_accepted: alignments (BAM, CRAM, FASTQ): not genomes the agent reads, and 30-100 GB
